name: Kanojo no Ane to no Ikenai Kankei ~Sakippo made tte Yakusoku na no ni...~
original_name: 彼女の姉とのイケない関係～先っぽまでって約束なのに…～
source:
I let out a sigh, looking over the thick bandage on my arm. The doctor told me it wasn’t a big deal, but still for me, an injury nonetheless.
Chisa, my girlfriend, had been away on a trip. I, on the other hand, had to sit still at home with this injury now, wasting away summer holidays.

On one of these days…

“yahoo---! How are you doing!”
“Hinami-san!?”

Hinami-san is Chisa’s elder sister. It would be hard to find someone at school who did NOT know her. That’s how much respected she was at school.

“What are you doing here?” 

Chisa apparently asked her to come see how I was doing and help out, since she couldn’t, being on a trip and all.

“Like, don’t let it bother you, ok? I’m more than glad to listen to my cute little sister’s request!”

------

She very gently takes off my clothes, to wipe my body. Her soft mellow hands carefully trace my body, her sweet fragrance wafting near me. 
I naturally get an erection.

“Ah! You must have bottled up, being like this for so long.” 

“yeah well, I mean, I usually have Chisa take care of it for me.”

Her hand wiping my body stopped, then slowly swept down, and started unzipping me.

“Now she isn't here to ‘take care of it’. let me do it in her place. No, I have to do it. I did accept her request to take care of you, and I have to show it.”

“No I can’t do anything to betray her trust…”

“It’s fine really. It’s not cheating as long as you don’t penetrate.”

translation:
我叹了口气，看着手臂上厚厚的绷带。医生告诉我这没什么大不了的，但对我来说仍然是一种伤害。
我的女朋友Chisa出差了。而我，现在却因伤只能坐在家里，浪费暑假。

在这些日子中的某一天……

“呀呼——！你怎么样！”
“日南同学！？”

日南同学是千纱的姐姐。在学校里很难找到不认识她的人。这就是她在学校受到的尊重。

“你在这里做什么？” 

奇萨显然让她来看看我的表现并提供帮助，因为她不能，因为正在旅行等等。

“就像，别让它打扰你，好吗？我很高兴听到我可爱的妹妹的请求！”

------

她很温柔地脱掉我的衣服，擦拭我的身体。她柔软的手小心翼翼地抚摸着我的身体，她的芳香在我身边飘荡。
我自然会勃起。

“啊！你这么久了，一定是憋着了吧。” 

“是啊，我的意思是，我通常都会让Chisa帮我处理这件事。”

她擦拭我身体的手停了下来，然后慢慢向下扫，开始拉开我的拉链。

“现在她不是来‘照顾’的了，让我来代替她吧。不，我必须这么做。我确实接受了她照顾你的请求，我必须表现出来。”

“不行，我不能做出任何辜负她信任的事情……”

“真的没关系，只要不渗透就不算作弊。”
